_comment: PRODUCTION identity lock: loads a PREBUILT face model (cast.yaml `face_model`) and swaps only the face on TARGET, preserving pose, expression, staging and lighting — use this to normalise a character across frames that are otherwise good, instead of regenerating and losing them. Batch-cheap because the model is loaded, not rebuilt; contrast reactor_faceswap.json which builds a model inline from 6 images per run (ad-hoc only). CRITICAL: build models from LOCKED refs, never from production frames — the 07-24 CTT models were built from already-polluted frames and so averaged in the very drift they were meant to fix. GOTCHA: models/facerestore_models/codeformer.pth is a BROKEN SYMLINK on this box; ReActor torch.loads it, gets None, and dies with a cryptic 'NoneType has no attribute seek' — hence GFPGANv1.4.pth. Calibration per reference_reactor-facelock-calibration: face_restore_visibility 0.5 (NOT 0.8), gender detection off (unreliable on AI faces). ReActor orders faces LARGE-SMALL (closest first), NOT left-to-right.

_meta.title: swap — input_faces_index selects WHICH face in a multi-person frame
